children: KESTRA MEDICAL TECHNOLOGIES, LTD. reported first-quarter 2027 results for the three months ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $30.97M, up 60% year over year, and a net loss attributable to common shareholders of $(44.09)M. Diluted EPS was $(0.75), compared with $(0.50) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $30.97M for Q1 2027, compared with $19.37M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 60%.
Net income was a loss of $(44.09)M for Q1 2027, compared with a loss of $(25.83)M in the prior-year quarter; change worsened by $18.26M.
Diluted EPS was $(0.75) for Q1 2027, compared with $(0.50) in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue growth was driven by increased patient use of the commercial-stage ASSURE® wearable cardiac defibrillator (WCD), contributing to a 60% YoY increase in quarterly revenue.
Nearly all revenue was derived from direct billing to Medicare, Medicaid and private payors; the company secured Medicare supplier accreditation.
Commercial expansion: Kestra increased sales and marketing headcount and investments to accelerate market penetration.
Operational scale: Manufacturing is outsourced to scalable contract partners; improved rental pool utilization and cost controls reduced per-patient costs.
Product and clinical progress: ASSURE® WCD is launched nationally with continued clinical investment and enhancements to the digital platform aimed at improving adherence.
